title: When Can I Sleep on My Side After Breast Augmentation?
meta_description: After about 3 to 4 weeks, per UW Medicine and University of Utah Health, if your surgeon agrees. What 2 weeks means, and how to sleep until then.
excerpt: A UW Medicine handout and University of Utah Health keep you on your back for the first 3 to 4 weeks and allow side sleeping after that, if your surgeon agrees. Here is what that means at 2, 3, 4 and 6 weeks, how to set up your bed, and how to get up without pushing with your arms.
quick_answer:
When can I sleep on my side after breast augmentation?

After about 3 to 4 weeks, if your surgeon agrees. A UW Medicine handout keeps you on your back for those weeks, and University of Utah Health says to wait that long and alternate sides at first. Your surgeon may ask for longer. For your stomach, UW Medicine says the same, and University of Utah Health says to ask first.
